summary: Google invests another $1B in Anthropic, on top of more than $2B invested earlier.
Google signs a framework for up to 3,000 MW of Brookfield hydro; first 20-year contracts cover 670 MW in Pennsylvania worth over $3B.
Amazon invests up to $4B in Anthropic for a minority stake, starting with $1.25B.
Amazon invests another $4B in Anthropic, which names AWS its primary training partner.
Amazon invests $5B in Anthropic and makes up to $20B more available through a financing facility, on top of $8B invested earlier.
Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI's $110B round at $730B pre-money: $15B up front and $35B once conditions were met, fully paid in Q3 2026.
AMD grants Meta a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares, vesting as Meta's purchases scale to 6 GW and AMD hits share price thresholds.
Warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares, vesting with GPU deployments and AMD share-price targets. No dollar value stated.
Anthropic expands to up to one million Google Cloud TPUs, well over 1 GW coming online in 2026, worth tens of billions of dollars.
Anthropic to spend more than $100B on AWS technologies over ten years.
Anthropic orders $10B of TPU Ironwood racks from Broadcom; disclosed as an unnamed customer in September, named in December.
Anthropic places a further $11B order with Broadcom for TPU racks.
Anthropic commits to buy $30B of Azure compute capacity.
ASML leads Mistral AI's Series C with EUR 1.3B for about 11% fully diluted, plus a long-term partnership.
Blackstone funds lead a $7.6B delayed draw loan facility for CoreWeave with Magnetar, Coatue and others; the amount is the syndicate total.
Blue Owl funds co-sponsor a $15B joint venture with Crusoe and Primary Digital for the 1.2 GW Abilene, Texas campus.
Blue Owl funds put about $7B cash into an 80/20 joint venture with Meta that owns the $27B Hyperion campus; Meta gets a one-time $3B distribution.
CoreWeave issues $350M of its stock to OpenAI as part of the compute contract.
Crusoe books 29 GE Vernova gas turbine packages, nearly 1 GW, for AI data centers. No value stated.
Meta reportedly signs a six-year Google Cloud deal worth over $10B, per one unnamed source. Neither company confirmed.
Meta to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, first gigawatt shipping in the second half of 2026. No dollar value stated.
Meta gives a capped residual value guarantee for the first 16 years of Hyperion and leases the campus for four years with extension options. Cap not disclosed.
Meta signs a 20-year deal for 1,121 MW from the Clinton nuclear plant starting June 2027. No value stated.
Meta commits up to about $14.2B for CoreWeave cloud capacity through December 2031, with an option to expand.
Meta signs a new five-year Nebius AI infrastructure agreement worth about $3B.
Meta signs for $12B of dedicated Nebius capacity on NVIDIA Vera Rubin over five years from early 2027, plus up to $15B of capacity Nebius cannot resell.
Meta commits to a multiyear build on millions of NVIDIA Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, Grace CPUs and Spectrum-X networking. No dollar value stated.
Meta signs 20-year deals for about 2,609 MW from three Vistra nuclear plants, including 433 MW of uprates. No value stated.
MGX is an initial equity funder of Stargate, planned at $500B over four years with $100B deployed first. No per-funder amount stated.
Microsoft commits to invest up to $5B in Anthropic.
Microsoft and Brookfield agree a framework for over 10.5 GW of new renewable capacity from 2026 to 2030. No value stated.
Microsoft signs a 20-year deal for about 835 MW from the restarted Crane nuclear plant, expected online in 2028. No value stated.
Microsoft signs a multiyear, multibillion-dollar deal for Lambda AI infrastructure on NVIDIA GB300 systems. No exact value stated.
Five-year GPU capacity agreement worth about $17.4B through 2031, up to about $19.4B with extra services.
Microsoft's total funding commitments to OpenAI are $13B, of which $11.8B was funded by March 31, 2026; about a 24% stake by September 2026.
NVIDIA commits to invest up to $10B in Anthropic.
NVIDIA places a $6.3B initial order to buy any CoreWeave capacity its customers leave unused, through April 2032.
NVIDIA buys $2B of CoreWeave Class A stock at $87.20 a share.
NVIDIA buys $5B of Intel common stock at $23.28 a share alongside a product partnership.
NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100B in OpenAI, paid in step with each gigawatt deployed; letter of intent.
NVIDIA provides $30B of OpenAI's $110B round; OpenAI adds 3 GW of NVIDIA inference capacity and 2 GW of training on Vera Rubin systems.
NVIDIA guarantees part of OpenAI's lease and power payments for about 4.25 GW at SB Energy's Ohio campus, capped at $105B; the site hosts NVIDIA systems.
OpenAI commits $38B over seven years for AWS compute on NVIDIA GPU clusters.
OpenAI expands its AWS commitment by $100B over eight years, including about 2 GW of Trainium capacity.
OpenAI to deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, first 1 GW in the second half of 2026. No dollar value stated.
OpenAI and Broadcom to deploy 10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerator racks from late 2026 to end of 2029. No dollar value stated.
OpenAI contracts up to $11.9B of AI compute from CoreWeave.
OpenAI expands its CoreWeave contract by up to $4B.
OpenAI expands its CoreWeave contract by up to $6.5B, about $22.4B across three contracts.
OpenAI commits to buy an incremental $250B of Azure services as part of its recapitalization.
OpenAI keeps paying Microsoft a revenue share through 2030 at the same percentage, subject to a total cap; Microsoft stops paying OpenAI a share. No figures stated.
OpenAI to deploy at least 10 GW of NVIDIA systems, first 1 GW on Vera Rubin in the second half of 2026; letter of intent. No dollar value stated.
OpenAI and Oracle agree to develop 4.5 GW of additional Stargate data center capacity in the US. No dollar value stated.
Samsung signs a letter of intent to supply DRAM to OpenAI's Stargate. No dollar value or volume share stated.
SK hynix signs a non-binding letter of intent to supply HBM to OpenAI's Stargate. Volumes and value to be set later.
OpenAI is an initial equity funder of Stargate, planned at $500B over four years with $100B deployed first. No per-funder amount stated.
Oracle is an initial equity funder of Stargate, planned at $500B over four years with $100B deployed first. No per-funder amount stated.
SoftBank buys $2B of Intel common stock at $23 a share.
SoftBank invests $30B of its own in OpenAI's $40B round at $300B post-money; completed December 2025 for about 11%.
SoftBank invests a further $30B in OpenAI in three $10B tranches through October 2026, reaching about 13%.
SoftBank is an initial equity funder of Stargate, planned at $500B over four years with $100B deployed first. No per-funder amount stated.
US government takes a 9.9% Intel stake: $8.9B for 433.3M shares at $20.47, funded by unpaid CHIPS grants and Secure Enclave money.
Final CHIPS award of up to $6.165B in direct funding for Micron's New York and Idaho fabs.
Final CHIPS award of up to $4.745B in direct funding for Samsung's Taylor and Austin, Texas fabs.
Final CHIPS award of up to $458M in direct funding for SK hynix's AI memory packaging plant in Indiana.
Final CHIPS award of up to $6.6B in direct funding for TSMC's three Phoenix fabs, plus about $5B of loans available.
